resolutions: The plan frontmatter is draft and its transition section requires the normal save, digest-bound approval, decomposition, task-plan grill, and task approval sequence before delegation.

The plan explicitly marks the protected old plan, decomposition, and First task plan inoperative for this amendment, then requires normal replacement of all three before the active stage continues. The matching external decomposition is already aligned and will be recorded only after plan approval.

The owner of each task carries that task in its own worktree through implementation, review fixes, PR, and green CI. The coordinator invokes review there under Decision 0011. Main owns only story scheduling and the separately authorized story-level client rollout.

The committed graph assigns AC6 to First, Lean, and Integration consistently with the plan crosswalk. First and Lean prove the task-bound diagnostic-versus-proof boundary; Integration proves the aggregate boundary.

First owns factory/schemas/review-set.json and factory/scripts/record_review_from_json.py. The one schema distinguishes origin=combined, origin=rejection, and origin=upgrade generations and validates the raw-plus-three-lens envelope and selected pointer.

The plan requires a preflight proving the three assessment markers and all quality verdict lines fit the installed helper's 3,000-character overall_explanation limit. Failure refuses before launch and requires an actual task or contract split; nothing is truncated or summarized.

Every top-level and nested provider pass is validated independently with exact full-line markers and exact chunk 1/N ordering. Projections filter the validated raw result by lens while preserving pass order, and existing score, recommendation, and worst quality-verdict rules define the aggregate. A missing, reordered, conflicting, or failed pass invalidates the generation.

The classified-product digest was removed. One factory_lib classifier now supplies the same sorted committed product paths and exclusions to review scope and current/historical binary branch-diff hashing; genuine contribution cites a path and hunk in that same diff. No product-tree snapshot or second digest exists.

The validated lowercase 32-hex source filename stem is authoritative because incumbent event payloads have no ID field. Bundle members preserve that stem plus the validated original payload, and exact canonical readback precedes source deletion.
Native lifecycle may detach only read-only helpers and supervisors. Implementation writers remain foreground and stage-bound; background write admission is refused and has no owner in this story.

The live handoff protocol was deleted. A coordinator may change only between completed tasks after the old session stops, refreshed trunk contains the marker and green CI, and no worker or partial structured question remains. The new coordinator resumes through forge next; no counter, snapshot, fencing token, registry, or concurrent ownership is added.

The committed inventory binds common directory, configured origin, canonical repository, and default branch for Cadence, MyClaw, and KnackLabs ATS. Every execution boundary revalidates those values. Toolshed has no remote and remains paused with zero mutation until the user supplies and approves its exact identity.

Format commits requirements-quality.txt with exact Ruff, Pyright, pytest, pytest-xdist, and psutil pins plus final ruff.toml before formatting. Quality consumes those bytes unchanged and makes the identical explicit source/test gate run on every branch push and pull request on Ubuntu and native Windows.
